skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

llm.summary: The tax-checking logic is local and purpose-aligned, but the skill makes a default outbound usage-count request using a hostname/username-derived identifier despite prominent no-network claims.

dimensions.detail: The runner reads the user-provided input file and performs local checks, but it also derives a stable short hash from hostname and username and sends it to https://www.tokendidi.cn/api/free-hint by default unless --no-stats is included.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill asks for Read and Bash and instructs users to run the packaged Node script. There is no package installation, dependency fetch, or remote code execution in the inspected artifacts.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill prominently says no network in the English description and opening documentation, while a later section and the runner disclose one anonymous stats request after successful runs; this disclosure is present but inconsistent and late.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No file writes, startup hooks, services, scheduled tasks, memory writes, or privilege escalation were found. The remote server can return display text after repeated runs, but the code only prints it to stderr and does not execute it.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core capability coherently checks a Chinese enterprise income tax adjustment table with local Node.js logic, but post-run telemetry to a remote server is not necessary for the tax checks and conflicts with the stated no-network positioning.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing in environments that restrict outbound network traffic or host/user telemetry. If used, run it with --no-stats or block the endpoint unless you accept the default usage-count request; the tax-checking code itself appears local and no destructive or persistent behavior was found.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: Downgraded: the referenced scripts/run.mjs file is present in the artifact and was fully inspected, so this appears to be scanner coverage limitation rather than artifact evasion.
[LP1] unexpected: Supported: scripts/run.mjs performs a fetch to a remote endpoint after successful runs, while the front matter and opening documentation present the skill as no-network/local.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Supported: the artifacts both claim no network and disclose later that a stats request is made; the implementation confirms the outbound request.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Supported: the sid is derived from os.hostname() and os.userInfo().username, hashed and truncated, then sent off-host as a stable installation identifier.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Partly supported: the local tax-checking engine itself does not use network, but the wrapper's default telemetry makes the broader no-network framing misleading.
[SQP-2] unexpected: Supported: the telemetry disclosure appears after usage instructions and after stronger local/no-network claims, reducing informed consent.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: the Chinese-language interface is coherent with a China enterprise income tax workflow; this is not by itself a security concern.
